title: •Colonel Wullf Yularen
caption: •Colonel Wullf Yularen (V)
game_text: Imperial Council Member. *Agenda:* logistics. ISB Agents are forfeit +1. While at Conference Room with Sim Aloo, may use 1 Force to subtract 1 from an opponent’s just drawn non-Epic Event destiny.
lore: Imperial Security Bureau (ISB) officer assigned to brief Tarkin. Also ordered to ensure absolute loyalty to the Emperor. *Leader*. Will stop at nothing to fulfill Emperor’s will.

'Agenda:' printed bold (colon inside the bold) → *Agenda:*. Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. Icon column: warrior only. No margin credits. Imperial (Premiere DS Imperial frame, Imperial disc). Copyright 'TM & © 1995 …' legible. Base scan 350 px only (wiki set 'Premiere Limited').
